newsitem.title: USA: Encore Medical's unit enters contract.
newsitem.headline: Encore Medical's unit enters contract.

text.p: Encore Medical Corp said Tuesday its Encore Orthopedics Inc subsidiary has entered into a comprehensive development and marketing agreement with Pro-LFIC LLC regarding a total hip replacement device.
Under the 15-year agreement, Encore becomes the exclusive, worldwide licensee for the Patented Lateral Flare Hip Technology.
The lateral flare concept addresses the preservation of bone stock in a unique manner by uniformly distributing stress to the patient's bone.
Encore Orthopedics designs, manufactures and markets products for the orthopedic device industry.
